data.title: 丛雨 · 金铃响在扫帚之后
data.description: 早晨的石阶上落了一层叶子。丛雨把宽袖往手肘收了收，握着竹帚从上往下扫。绯袴随步子展开一线，红绳上的金铃轻响。最后一片叶子赶在日光照到台阶前滑进了簸箕。
data.action: 握竹帚顺石阶清扫落叶
data.lighting: 从鸟居后斜射过来的朝阳逐级照亮石面
data.camera: 石阶下方略侧的全身远景
data.promptProse: Murasame sweeps leaves down the stone steps before the shrine opens. The wide white kimono sleeves are gathered back from the broom handle, red hakama pleats part as she moves, and the little gold bells at her waist jingle on their cords. The last leaf slides into the dustpan before the stair catches the sun.
data.animaCaption: Her lacquered geta stop above the dustpan as the broom nudges the last leaf off the step.
